data.text:
M2 and M3 are done and installed in the owner's pack (2026-11-19; branch time-sweep-spike, uncommitted).
- **M2:** F7 records a moment to memento/moments/<id>.json. It holds camera, time, weather, the player, and up to 48 entities with server NBT (SNBT). At most 10 are queued.
- **M3 darkroom:** starts after the title screen is idle (darkroomIdleSeconds, default 30).
  - Copies saves/.memento-darkroom: level.dat, data/, datapacks/, and the region files near the subject only. No entities/.
  - Writes players/data/<localUuid>.dat: creative, flying, at the recorded spot.
  - Opens that world under a DarkroomOverlay.
  - Commands: gamerule spawn_mobs/spawn_monsters false, difficulty normal, time, weather.
  - Places the actors client-side, then runs ShotDirector.develop and disconnects. Harness: about 13–16 s per moment.
- **Gotchas:**
  - Minecraft.doWorldLoad waits while ANY overlay is up (DarkroomWorldLoadMixin hides ours).
  - EntityType.create refuses monsters in PEACEFUL, so load peaceful and switch to normal before placing.
  - 26.3 save layout: players/data/<uuid>.dat and dimensions/<ns>/<dim>/{region,entities,poi}.
  - Game rule ids are snake_case (spawn_mobs).
  - EntityType.byString and EntityType.PLAYER are gone; use BuiltInRegistries and instanceof Player.
  - The harness world copy must exclude session.lock while the owner plays.
- **Photo profile:** Iris.resetShaderPackOptionsOnNextReload plus cancelling Iris.tryUpdateConfigPropertiesFile while it is active. Verified that the owner's pack .txt is unchanged (sha).
- **Backups (scratchpad):** owner gallery in owner-memento-backup/, previous jar memento-m1-backup.jar.
- **Next:** M4 FA wrapper, M5 selection.
